name: TensorFold 1.3.3 reaches 172 tok/s on GLM 5.3 Flash after a 1M-token prompt on 4 DGX Sparks
title: TensorFold 1.3.3 reaches 172 tok/s on GLM 5.3 Flash after a 1M-token prompt on 4 DGX Sparks
headline: TensorFold 1.3.3 speeds decode after 1M-token prompts
lede: A new long-context kernel in TensorFold 1.3.3 lifts decode after a 1M-token prompt from 151.5 to 172 tok/s, with identical output tokens.

effects.effect: Long-context kernels keep improving local throughput
